summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around the HBM stack and advanced-packaging process chain, emphasizing one-layer-beneath-HBM suppliers rather than memory producers. The strongest underfollowed lane candidates are process-tool, inspection/metrology, probe-card/test, and wafer-level advanced-packaging equipment names whose relevance comes from die stacking, thermocompression bonding, wafer-level processing, HBM inspection, and yield management. No buy/sell view is implied; this is a research-universe expansion only.
